limitations: Groups and variants are numeric source selectors; move names, strength labels, input mapping and cancel behavior are not inferred.
A graph cycle describes animation pointer behavior only; gameplay may interrupt it before the cycle.
Original signed-byte timers are retained as both raw and signed values; no replacement timing is authored.
Hit data and flags are preserved without assigning unverified damage, stun or cancel meanings.
